params.prompt:
Create ORIGINAL NEW PRODUCTION SPRITES for the existing Coaster Grove game. The reference images are its current expansion-v4 assets. Match their PIXEL ART style, outline strength, material colors, simple clustered highlights and adult miniature-game scale. Authentic late1990s PC park management sprites, crisp squarepixel clusters, hard staircase silhouettes, 2-3 flat palette shades per material. No smooth/vector illustration, no photorealism, no 3Drender, no gradients, no soft lighting, no textures, no antialiasing, no blur. Use coral red, turquoise/teal, cream, warmgold, restrained brown and darkgreen. Deep violet accent allowed but NEVER magenta on objects.
All objects in ISOMETRIC ORTHOGRAPHIC 2:1 projection: screen ground edges travel TWO pixels horizontally for ONE vertically, azimuth45degrees/elevation26.565degrees. No converging perspective. Lighting fromupperleft matching reference.
TRANSPARENCY PRODUCTION BACKDROP: uniformly bright MAGENTA #FF00FF to be keyed out, perfectly flat including every gap/hole between components. No castgroundshadows, no background, no landscape, no grassfloor, no parkpaths, no pavement, no decorative displaybases unless an actual ride component. No text, labels, letters, cellnumbers, gridlines, borders, logos or interface. Every object fully separate and fully inside its owncell with at least15percent clear margin.
EXACT ATLAS: FOUR equal columns by THREE equal rows, twelve equal SQUARE cells, overall4:3. ExactlyONE complete isolated requested object percell. No omitted or repeatedcells. Eachcell represents128x128 logicalpixels enlarged nearest-neighbor. Keep tiny gameasset silhouettes, not detailed illustrations.

ROW1: FOUR directions of exactlythe SAME PARK RAILWAY LOCOMOTIVE. Cute but adult proportioned small narrow-gauge park steamengine, warmred cylindrical boiler, teal drivercab with creamroof, dark smokestack, golden bands, small darkwheels, NO smoke, NO driver, NO rail, NO coaches. About46x34 logicalpixels. All4views identicalsize. Clear long enginefront and flat enclosedcabback.
Column1 front points SCREEN LOWER RIGHT(SE).
Column2 front points SCREEN LOWER LEFT(SW).
Column3 front points SCREEN UPPER LEFT(NW), expose BACK of drivercab.
Column4 front points SCREEN UPPER RIGHT(NE), expose BACK of drivercab.
Rearviews must genuinely show cabback; do not duplicate frontviews.
ROW2: FOUR directions of exactlythe SAME SMALL PARK SHUTTLE BUS. Compact real passenger shuttle, cream rectangularbody, teal lowerbody and roofstrip, large darkblue windows, coralred front bumper, two axles with four darkwheels, obvious large frontwindshield versus solidrearpanel with twotiny redtail-lights. No branding, no words, no riders, no roadway. About48x32logicalpixels. Sameconsistent scale as locomotive. Columns1SE(frontlower-right),2SW(frontlower-left),3NW(frontupper-left/backvisible),4NE(frontupper-right/backvisible). Correct facingorientation and differentfront/back.
ROW3 leftto right, four NEW compact servicebuildings:
1 PARK TRAIN STATION: small golden timber waitingplatform under cream-and-teal gabledcanopy, coral trim, tiny freestanding round clockface with no text, short narrow-gauge steeltrack segment on brownsleepers through shelter, no locomotive. About72x62logicalpixels. Onlyactualstation, no groundtile.
2 SHUTTLE BUS STOP: compact tealmetalshelter with creamroof, clear openfront, goldenbench beneath, shortcoral stoppost with simple emptyroundsign, no bus, no roadway. About54x48logicalpixels.
3 BALLOON SELLER KIOSK: tiny cream squarestall, coral stripedawning, tealservingcounter and a cluster of six distinctround inflatedBALLOONS in coral/turquoise/gold/cream tied above onecorner by thinstrings. Balloon silhouettes must be unmistakable. No vendor. About56x68logicalpixels includingballoons.
4 PLUSH TOY SELLER KIOSK: tiny cream stall with tealroof/coralawning and wideopenshelf showing THREE simple stuffed TEDDYBEAR silhouettes in warmbrown/cream/coraltone, roundedears and seatedpaws; larger goldenbearsign fixedonroof. No vendor, no text. About56x60logicalpixels.
Exactly12 isolated sprites.

processing: Technical processing only: atlas-cell extraction with gutter corrections (transport last row begins y816, final-row first column ends x512; rides last row begins y840, first-row first column ends x512), bright-magenta key to binary alpha, transparent trim, common isotropic nearest-neighbor scale per vehicle direction group, fixed logical canvas/pivot normalization, exact4x nearest-neighbor PNG copies. The generated NW locomotive pointed NE and is horizontally reflected for its declared NW heading. No visual features painted or synthesized by code. Dark violet object colors retained.

visualReview.result: Readable coherent pixelart matching expansion-v4, isolated ride components, transparent holes and correctly cropped balloon tops and buildings. Four transport headings after NW locomotive reflection. Eight seated rider views match the original red/teal guests.
limitations: NW locomotive originally duplicated the NE-facing direction; a technical horizontal reflection corrects direction but mirrors baked lighting.
Orbital-spinner catalogue icon has two visible arms/gondolas rather than three. Components are separate, so renderer can assemble the desired count.
One cup/arm/gondola angle is provided; orientation, orbit and occlusion are renderer work.
Seated riders include short bent legs; mask lower body behind vehicle shell. No separate hand-held balloon or teddy asset was generated because the two main jobs had already been submitted.
Projection follows the fixed pixel reference; exact geometric2:1 consistency is visually assessed, not mathematically guaranteed.
